summary: Validated owner admin login, team management, invite/accept, role-gated tabs, registration lockdown, and change-password flows end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass (7 existing + 5 new) and 12/12 frontend Playwright checks pass after a minor clipboard-rejection fix in AdminTeam.js.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() rejection was unhandled. In preview/headless context the browser threw 'NotAllowedError: Write permission denied' producing a fullscreen 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay although the backend invite was created successfully. FIXED in this iteration by wrapping the call in try/catch.

rca of the issue: Only one functional issue surfaced and was fixed: unhandled promise rejection from navigator.clipboard.writeText() in AdminTeam.invite(). Repro: log in as owner, open Admin Panel -> Team -> Invite by email, click Send invite. In preview (headless/non-focused) Chrome the clipboard write rejects with NotAllowedError; the un-awaited promise propagated as an uncaught error overlay. Fix: wrap the writeText call in try/catch; toast still displays the link in its description so the invite remains copy-pasteable.
